description: The Capacity Expansion Regional Feasibility (CERF) Model: High-Resolution Power Plant Siting is a model or code deposit deposited in DOE Pacific Northwest National Laboratory (PNNL) Repository by its authors Kendall Mongird, Chris Vernon. Abstract This presentation gives an overview of the geospatial power plant siting model CERF. CERF (Capacity Expansion Regional Feasibility) is an open source Python package developed under the Integrated Multisector Multiscale Modeling (IM3) Project at PNNL.
